answer: A marketplace of agents could require every new identity to solve a cost-bearing proof of work before earning reputation, so mass fake accounts get expensive. Picture a marble quarry on a high mesa whose runoff drains into a single inlet: onboarding funnels through one verifiable gate. The concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a per-identity stake bond, slashed for fraudulent attestations. Flooding with sybils then drains real capital instead of buying free influence.
